safeguards.label: Remote desktop hidden from the internet
safeguards.problem: remote desktop (RDP, port 3389) open to the internet
safeguards.ok_text: remote desktop is not visible from the internet
safeguards.fix: Remove the port 3389 forwarding on the router. Use a VPN to work from home.

safeguards.label: Every computer has a different admin password
safeguards.problem: the same admin password on several computers
safeguards.ok_text: every computer has its own admin password
safeguards.fix: Set different admin passwords (Windows LAPS does it automatically). Work day to day on accounts without admin rights.

safeguards.label: System and programs up to date
safeguards.fix: Turn on automatic updates for the system and programs.

safeguards.label: Drives encrypted
safeguards.fix: Turn on BitLocker on Windows or FileVault on a Mac.

safeguards.label: Two-step login (MFA) on email accounts
safeguards.problem: email accounts sign in with a password alone
safeguards.fix: Turn on MFA (for example an Authenticator app) on every email account. Start with the people who pay invoices.

safeguards.label: SPF record
safeguards.fix: Add an SPF record at your domain provider.

safeguards.label: DMARC record (protection against spoofing)
safeguards.problem: domain without DMARC, anyone can send email in the company's name
safeguards.fix: Add a _dmarc TXT record with p=quarantine, after 2 weeks p=reject.

safeguards.label: Account number changes are confirmed by phone
safeguards.problem: an email is enough to change an account number
safeguards.ok_text: account number changes are always confirmed by phone
safeguards.fix: Set a rule: account number changes are confirmed by phone on the number from the contract. Print it and pin it by the desk of the person who makes payments.

safeguards.label: A backup kept off the network
safeguards.problem: backups are always connected and would be encrypted with everything else
safeguards.fix: Once a week back up to a USB drive that you disconnect and put away afterwards.

safeguards.label: Backup restore tested
safeguards.problem: nobody has checked whether files can be restored from the backup
safeguards.fix: Restore one folder from the backup and check that the files open.

safeguards.label: Website and plugins up to date
safeguards.problem: outdated website software, for example WordPress
safeguards.fix: Turn on automatic updates at your host.

safeguards.label: HTTPS and a valid certificate
safeguards.problem: website without HTTPS or with an expiring certificate
safeguards.fix: Turn on HTTPS at your host.
